This repository contains a Python trading screener for Indian equities.

Instructions:
- Work with the existing codebase first; do not rebuild from scratch unless necessary.
- Market scope: NSE and BSE only.
- Optimize for very fast scanning and near-real-time behavior.
- Avoid one-by-one processing when possible.
- Prefer batching, concurrency, caching, vectorized calculations, and incremental updates.
- Filter illiquid symbols early.
- Avoid redundant scanning of duplicate listings across NSE and BSE.
- Improve breakout detection, momentum ranking, volume surge logic, relative strength, and liquidity-aware scoring.
- Focus on practical refactoring, debugging, profiling, and performance improvements.
- Keep code modular, maintainable, and fast.
- Do not output generic disclaimers or boilerplate.
